message.content:
Here's a comprehensive guide to setting up a new router for WiFi access:

## 1. Unbox and Prepare

First, check that you have all the necessary items:
- Router unit
- Power adapter
- Ethernet cable(s)
- Quick start guide (with default login credentials)

## 2. Choose the Right Location

Place your router in a **central, elevated location** for optimal WiFi coverage. Avoid:
- Closets or cabinets
- Basements or corners
- Areas near thick walls, metal objects, or interference sources (microwaves, cordless phones)

## 3. Connect the Hardware

| Step | Action |
|------|--------|
| 1 | **Power off your modem** (unplug for 30 seconds) |
| 2 | Connect one end of an Ethernet cable to your **modem's LAN port** |
| 3 | Connect the other end to your **router's WAN/Internet port** (usually blue or yellow) |
| 4 | Plug in the router's power adapter and turn it on |
| 5 | Wait 1-2 minutes for both devices to sync up |

For initial configuration, you can also connect a computer directly to a **LAN port** on the router using another Ethernet cable for a more stable connection.

## 4. Access the Router's Settings

1. **Connect to the router's default WiFi** or use the wired connection
   - Find the default network name (SSID) and password on the router's label

2. **Open a web browser** and enter the router's default IP address:
   - Common addresses: `192.168.0.1`, `192.168.1.1`, or `192.168.2.1`
   - Check your router's label for the exact address

3. **Log in** with the default username and password (usually "admin/admin" or "admin/password")

> **Security tip:** Change the default admin password immediately to prevent unauthorized access.

## 5. Configure Your WiFi Network

Navigate to the **Wireless** or **WiFi Settings** section:

| Setting | Recommendation |
|---------|---------------|
| **Network Name (SSID)** | Choose a unique, recognizable name |
| **Password** | Use a strong password (8+ characters with letters, numbers, and symbols) |
| **Security/Encryption** | Select **WPA3** if available; otherwise use **WPA2** |
| **WiFi Band** | Enable both 2.4 GHz (better range) and 5 GHz (faster speeds) if available |

## 6. Set Up Internet Connection

In the **Internet** or **WAN** settings, select your connection type:
- **PPPoE**: Most common for home broadband (requires username/password from your ISP)
- **Dynamic IP/DHCP**: Automatic configuration
- **Static IP**: Fixed IP address (less common for home users)

## 7. Save, Restart, and Test

1. Click **Save** or **Apply** to confirm all settings
2. **Restart the router** when prompted
3. **Test your connection** by connecting devices to your new WiFi network and browsing the internet

## Optional Advanced Settings

- **Update firmware** for improved security and performance
- **Enable QoS** to prioritize bandwidth for streaming/gaming
- **Set up guest network** for visitors
- **Configure parental controls** if needed
- **Disable WPS** for enhanced security

---

**Sources:**
1. https://posvirtual.fapam.edu.br/fapam-news/easy-router-wifi-setup-guide-1764800295
2. https://www.actcorp.in/blog/how-to-configure-router
3. https://www.splashaccess.com/how-to-install-new-router/
4. https://informaticacero.com/configurar-router/
5. https://blog.masmovil.es/como-configurar-el-router-paso-a-paso-y-desde-cero/
6. https://www.juyuwang.cn/shezhi/65847.html
7. http://product.pconline.com.cn/itbk/top/qa/1863/18635638.html
